name: ACH Food Companies - Argo Manufacturing Location
old_description: From corn oil to cooking spray, MAZOLA has been helping families create delicious meals and cook with care since 1911.
about:
ACH Food Companies operates its Argo manufacturing location in Summit, Illinois. The business traces its roots to 1868 with the establishment of Fleischmann's Yeast, while the Mazola corn oil brand launched in 1911. The company has been a subsidiary of Associated British Foods since 2000, though ownership details are not specified in the source material.

The facility produces a range of cooking and baking ingredients under heritage brands. Core processes include corn oil extraction and refining for Mazola products, cornstarch manufacturing for Argo, syrup production for Karo, and yeast cultivation for Fleischmann's. The company states it manufactures and markets some of North America's top-selling cooking and baking ingredients, though specific facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not disclosed.

Products reach retail consumers and foodservice channels across the United States and Canada. Primary industries served include consumer packaged goods, retail grocery, and baking ingredient supply. Brand examples from the input include Mazola corn oil and cooking sprays, Argo cornstarch, Karo syrups, and Fleischmann's yeast — all positioned as staple items for home bakers and cooks.

The company emphasizes reliable performance across generations, citing a portfolio of trusted brands that span multiple categories. Its stated values — passion, accountability, results, and creativity — frame a focus on executional excellence and consumer-driven innovation rather than any single technical differentiator.
